data.name: Pacomius
data.gender_notes: Pacomius is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'pacis' meaning 'peace' and 'mus' meaning 'servant'. Pacomius is a name given to those who are dedicated to serving God and living a peaceful life. The name Pacomius carries the meaning “Servant of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Pacomius usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing devotion and service to God.
data.etymology: Pacomius belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pacomius total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_latin.name: Pacomius
in_latin.long_meaning: Pacomius is a name derived from Egyptian origins, signifying he who opens the way or the one who makes a path, this name holds significant importance in Christian tradition, particularly in reference to Saint Pacomius, the founder of Christian monasticism in Egypt.

in_english.meaning: he who opens the way for his brothers
in_english.long_meaning: Pacomius is a Christian name originating from Egyptian roots, meaning he who opens the way for his brothers, this name has significant historical and spiritual importance, particularly in relation to Saint Pacomius, who founded Christian monasticism in Egypt, embodying a life of devotion, community, and spiritual guidance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Pacomius has its origins in the Latin language, highlighting the historical and cultural connections between the Western world and the spread of early Christianity. For many centuries, this name was popular in the Eastern Orthodox Church, particularly in Coptic Egyptian monasteries, reflecting the significant influence of both Roman and Egyptian cultures on Christian spirituality and monastic practices.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Pacomius carries a profound spiritual significance as it signifies a commitment to serve God through a life rooted in peace and serenity. The name itself is a reminder of the Biblical teaching to "strive for peace with everyone, and for the holiness without which no one will see the Lord" (Hebrews 12:14). The name inspires one to seek inner peace, undisturbed by external circumstances, and to extend that peace to others in their community, creating a more harmonious and spiritually enriching world.
